tutorial.say: A clue shaped like this next to a row (or above a column) counts the LONGEST RUN of bombs in the line: the most bombs you can follow side by side without a gap. Shorter runs are ignored.
This row has four bombs, but they come as a run of three and a lone bomb. The longest run is three, so the clue says 3.
It tells you a limit: no run in this row can be longer than that, and a run that long must exist. Remember multipliers: a bomb on a multiplier counts double inside the run.

tutorial.play: Your turn! The board is cleared again. Find all the bombs.
